preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges of weight 1 in the graph is between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is either n*(n-1)/2 or 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices, which are numbered from 1 to n.
No edge connects a vertex to itself.

preconditions.expression: The graph is undirected and complete.
preconditions.description: Each pair of vertices is connected by exactly one edge, which may have weight 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: No edge appears twice in the input.
preconditions.description: Each edge is listed exactly once in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is the weight of the minimum spanning tree of the graph.
If there are no edges of weight 1, the weight of the minimum spanning tree is 0.
If there are fewer than n-1 edges of weight 1, the minimum spanning tree will include all of them, so the weight is m.
If there are at least n-1 edges of weight 1, the minimum spanning tree will include n-1 edges, so the weight is n-1.
